data.title: 尤贝尔 · 黑森林宅邸的花嫁试探
data.description: 【森林边缘旧宅·薄暮】尤贝尔穿着黑色婚纱靠在藤蔓拱门旁，绿发侧马尾被头纱轻轻压住；她没有按仪式站直，而是伸手拨弄捧花里的小刀形叶片，用半睁的紫瞳向镜头露出像在提问的笑。
data.action: 藤蔓拱门旁拨弄捧花里的叶片，头纱压住侧马尾，半睁紫瞳试探回眸
data.mood: 危险好奇心里的花嫁反差
data.promptProse: Rather than standing ceremonially, Ubel leans against the overgrown arch and toys with a leaf in her wildflower bouquet, studying the viewer with half-lidded purple eyes. A translucent veil presses her green side ponytail above a black long-sleeved bridal gown with green embroidery. The vertical medium-full view includes vines curling behind her. Violet twilight outlines the veil and foliage; firefly pinpoints punctuate the deepening garden without replacing its soft shadows.
